title: Expanding solutions to the compressible Navier-Stokes equations with degenerate viscosities in spherical symmetry: global existence and inviscid limit
summary: This paper is devoted to studying the strong solutions to the vacuum free boundary problem for the isentropic compressible Navier-Stokes equations with density-dependent viscosities under spherical symmetry, which models the motions of isentropic compressible viscous flows surrounded by vacuum. We construct a class of expanding global solutions when the initial data is a small perturbation of the expanding affine solutions for the adiabatic exponent $γ>1$ and the viscosity coefficients proportional to $ρ^γ$, with $ρ$ being the fluid density.
